bundle.shortDescription: Uninstall apps and clean up what they leave behind.
bundle.longDescription: Uninstall applications properly and clean up what previous uninstalls left behind. Nothing is ever deleted — every removal moves to the Trash or Recycle Bin, behind a review sheet showing every path and the reason it matched. Free and open-source, by BiswasHost.
